product.description: Descoperă pictogramele și începe să citești cu ajutor! Ascultă povestea pe care părintele tău o citește cu voce tare și participă la lectură rostind cuvintele reprezentate prin imagini. În felul acesta vei urmări mai ușor firul poveștii, iar lectura va deveni una dintre activitățile tale preferate.   Această serie cu pictograme: • încurajează și dezvoltă abilitățile de citire. • este perfectă pentru momentele împreună cu cel mic. • este ideală ca poveste de seară, dar și pentru orice moment al zilei. Prima mea lectură este o colecție special creată pentru a-i ghida pas cu pas pe preșcolari și pe școlari în aventura cititului. Formatul accesibil, textele ilustrate și adaptate la nivelul de înțelegere al vârstei, succesul de care se bucură aceste cărți în lumea întreagă și premiile primite îi motivează pe copii să-și cultive interesul pentru lectură: Nivelul 1 – 5-6 ani • Nivelul 2 – 6-7 ani • Nivelul 3 – 6-7 ani Nivelul 4 – 7-8 ani • Nivelul 5 – 8-9 ani • Nivelul 6 – 8-9 ani

# Frumoasa Adormita Picture Book: Guided Reading for Early Learners (Level 1)

**Brand:** Litera
**Category:** Children's Educational Books
**Price:** $24.99

---

## Start Their Literacy Journey with *Frumoasa Adormita*

Help your child discover the joy of reading and build essential pre-literacy skills with this engaging picture book series. *Frumoasa Adormita* (The Beautiful Sleeping Beauty) provides a unique, supportive approach to learning how to read, perfect for preschoolers and early grade readers. This Level 1 volume is designed to guide children step-by-step through the exciting adventure of reading aloud.

This educational storybook combines familiar narratives with visual aids, transforming structured learning into an enjoyable shared activity between parent and child.

## Features Designed for Young Readers

More than just a fairytale, this book is a comprehensive tool built to enhance your child's understanding of language and text structure.

### ð Interactive Guided Reading Experience
The concept encourages the parent to read the story aloud while the child actively participates by reading words represented through accompanying pictures (pictograms). This method helps children:
*   **Follow the Narrative Arc:** Easily track the plot and sequence of events in the story.
*   **Build Confidence:** Turn reading into a fun, collaborative experience that makes it feel like play.
*   **Develop Reading Skills:** Start associating written words with their corresponding images.

### ð Perfect for Shared Story Time
Whether you are settling down for a bedtime routine or engaging in circle time, this book is ideal for connecting moments. It provides an accessible format and beautifully illustrated texts tailored to the child's current level of understanding.

## A Progressive Reading Series for Growing Minds

This *Frumoasa Adormita* collection is structured as a multi-level series, ensuring that your child's learning progresses naturally as their skills develop. The acclaimed nature of these books means they are trusted globally by educators and parents alike.

The levels guide children through various stages of literacy development:
*   **Level 1:** Ideal for ages 5â6 years (Perfect starter volume).
*   **Level 2 & 3:** For 6â7 year olds.
*   **Level 4:** Designed for 7â8 year olds.
*   **Level 5 & 6:** For 8â9 year olds, supporting advanced reading skills.

By starting with Level 1, your child receives a gentle introduction to the magical world of print literacy!

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Q: Is this book only for bedtime?**
A: No! While it is wonderful for calming story time before sleep, the engaging format makes it suitable for any moment during the day when you want an interactive learning session.

**Q: Does my child need to know how to read already?**
A: No. The design is specifically intended as a guided activity where the parent reads initially, helping the child participate and build skills gradually.

**Q: What makes this series different from standard storybooks?**
A: Unlike traditional storybooks, this series incorporates pictograms alongside the text, allowing children to visually track meaning while they learn to decode and read words independently.
